featured.title: Exams and reporting, automated for a graduate and postgraduate institute
featured.summary: Unique Educational Institute runs a range of graduate and postgraduate courses in Dwarka, New Delhi. Friensys digitised its academic administration so exams, results and reports no longer depend on manual registers and spreadsheets.
challenge: Several UG and PG programmes, each with its own exam pattern and reporting needs
Marks, results and reports compiled by hand, which was slow and error-prone at every exam cycle
Management had no single, up-to-date view of academic performance
solution: Deployed Friensys College ERP (Institute Management System), configured for the institute's course and examination structure
Digital marks entry, automatic result processing and report generation
Role-based access for administrators, faculty and management
Implementation, data migration, staff training and ongoing support
outcomes: Exam and reporting cycles run on one system instead of registers and spreadsheets
Results and reports generated automatically from the marks entered
Management sees academic data in one place, when they need it
featured.quote: Friensys has made school management effortless, improving exams and reporting at Unique Educational Institute. We recommend Friensys for any institution looking for smooth automation and real results.

featured.title: A customer loyalty programme for a textile manufacturer and retailer
featured.summary: VK Enterprises manufactures and retails textiles. Friensys built and runs the loyalty programme that rewards its customers and gives the business a direct line to them.
challenge: No structured way to reward repeat customers across its retail business
Customer purchase history scattered, so promotions went to everyone rather than the right people
Needed a programme simple enough for store staff and customers to use from day one
solution: Deployed the Friensys Customer Loyalty platform, configured for VK's business
Points, tiers, coupons and campaigns, with web and mobile access for customers
Analytics on customers, redemptions and campaign performance
Ongoing support and enhancements as the programme grows
outcomes: One loyalty programme for customers, with points, tiers and coupons
Campaigns targeted using real purchase and redemption data
A customer database the business owns, ready for AI-driven offers and churn prediction
featured.quote: VK Enterprise utilizes Friensys solutions to streamline operations, improve team collaboration, and enhance client communication — driving greater productivity and business efficiency.

featured.title: Building and running a K-12 ERP for 100+ institutions since 2017
featured.summary: School ERP is our own product. We designed it, built it and have run it in production since 2017 — today it handles admissions, fees, exams, attendance and parent communication for 100+ institutions across 12 states, with AI already working inside it.
challenge: Indian K-12 schools ran on registers, spreadsheets and disconnected tools
Every board (CBSE, ICSE, state boards) and every school does things slightly differently
Administrators lose hours to attendance, report cards and fee follow-ups
solution: A modular platform of 40+ modules, from admissions to graduation
Parent, student and teacher mobile app and an admissions CRM
AI-enabled attendance and automatic grade-card generation, live in production
Cloud hosting, DPDPA-aligned data handling, and support for every customer
outcomes: AI features running for real users — the same engineering we bring to client projects
